subject: The Daily Crunch: AI startup raises $100M
body:
Good morning! Here's what you need to know today:

TOP STORIES

1. AI startup Anthropic raises $100M in Series C funding
   The company plans to use the funds to accelerate development of their AI assistant.

2. Apple announces new MacBook Pro with M3 chip
   The latest iteration promises 40% better performance.

3. Tesla stock hits all-time high amid EV demand surge
